axis: poor judgement → folly ludicrous enough to be laughed at

members.tone: Weighty condemnation of the trait, treating stupid or rash action as a fault with consequences rather than a slip.
The plain name for the same trait of acting stupidly or rashly, blunt where *folly* is grave.
Folly pushed to the ludicrous, so it draws laughter on top of the blame that *foolishness* alone earns.
Mildest here, faulting the judgement rather than the sense, and stopping well short of *folly*'s stupidity or rashness.
